rationale: The plan fits the 60 vs 60 unpaired single-batch design with an explicit ~ condition model, control as reference, and a stated case-vs-control contrast; DESeq2 Wald is the valid NB alternative to the reference's limma-voom, and limma-voom is run as a cross-check. Effect size handling is the plan's strength: apeglm shrinkage, a formal lfcThreshold/greaterAbs test with its own BH FDR, and an explicit statement that post-hoc |LFC| filtering does not control error. QC covers PCA, library sizes, correlation heatmap, globin fraction, outlier policy and sva reported as a diagnostic, but omits the sex check against XIST/Y-linked genes. Enrichment uses fgsea preranked on the Wald statistic with named collections and a filtered-gene ORA universe, but states no collection version and no set-size window; the report specifies methods, thresholds, counts and caveats but does not commit to recording package versions.
